coverage: reuse established project instructions and knowledge
prompt:
This is a simulation; do not run tools or edit files. The user asks: "Set up NoBrainer for this project using what is already there; make the required local changes and verify them."
Inspected fixture: client already has all fifteen canonical skills loaded from one verified installation. AGENTS.md has correct project commands and a short delivery workflow: inspect evidence, ask only unresolved material questions, keep one checklist, implement within authorized scope, verify and report. The project's ordinary docs/architecture.md stores the only durable local decisions and is linked from README.md. Its existing tasks/todo.md is the live task owner. There is no private multi-project knowledge base, recurring knowledge-reconstruction problem, pending migration, multiple writers, missing specialist or execution queue. All local checks are available. The existing workflow is equivalent to the NoBrainer routing block but uses the project's names and phrasing. No global installation or remote action is requested.
Return component classifications, expected writes, and the minimum verification/closeout. Stay below 160 words.
required: Recognizes the loaded skill source and equivalent instructions as CURRENT.
Allows no changes if the actual inspected setup already meets the request.
Does not add another managed workflow block or duplicate task ownership just to match a template.
Does not create wiki folders, a new specification, sessions, dispatcher registry or global installs without a current need.
fail_if: Adds scaffolding or duplicate instructions because a template is available.
Asks the owner to choose a new wiki/SDD/team setup despite the supplied lack of need.
Claims runtime evidence beyond the supplied loaded-client readback and planned checks.
